name: What is kitchen cabinet refacing?
description: Kitchen cabinet refacing updates your kitchen's look by replacing cabinet doors/drawer fronts and applying new veneer to existing boxes.

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen cabinet refacing involves replacing cabinet doors and drawer fronts with new ones, and applying a new veneer to the existing cabinet boxes. This process changes the look of your kitchen cabinets without requiring a full tear-out and replacement of the cabinet boxes. It's often a more cost-effective and less disruptive alternative to a full kitchen remodel, and is suitable when your existing cabinet boxes are structurally sound. We ensure the new doors and veneer match your desired style and color palette.
